title: Attach coordinated severity adjectives to their finding noun in summary diagnostics
outcome: For ordinary child summary diagnostics, decide and implement how coordinated severity adjectives such as 'Found Critical and Low issues.' and 'Found High- and Low-severity issues.' attach to the following finding noun. Preserve diagnostic-only authority, explicit findings, AsBefore recovery, and the closed CLEAN contract. Add targeted controls for the intended highest qualifying severity.
acceptance: Attach coordinated severity adjectives to their finding noun in summary diagnostics is done
